'The edge returned 403' alone does not establish that WordPress never saw it.

THE FACE TREATS AC2 AND AC3 AS INDEPENDENT AND THEY ARE NOT: the /wp-admin and xmlrpc.php source-restriction rule is the ONLY refusal mechanism this face is authorized to build, because the managed groups are mandated to COUNT and both reused IP sets are empty by design. So the missing allow-list does not merely make AC3 uncomputable -- it removes AC2's only available demonstration. This is filed as UNCOMPUTABLE rather than FAIL because the blocking input was never supplied and the face forbids inventing it. A ruling that xmlrpc.php may be blocked outright for all sources would make this criterion satisfiable immediately without any address being guessed.

Reading that 405 as 'already hardened' would be a false negative.

mutant.description: The face names the control that must be able to FAIL: S13-AC1's 404 negative control, without which a catch-all edge returning 200 to everything would read as a working site. The mutant this face is exposed to is a CloudFront custom_error_response mapping 404 to a 200 shell -- the exact configuration that silently converts the criterion into a tautology, and the shape this project was fooled by earlier today.
mutant.expected: If the control is real, the SAME instrument must return DIFFERENT verdicts on the two classes of path: 200 on paths that exist and 404 on paths that do not. A catch-all edge cannot produce both.
mutant.observed: It returned both, on 6 requests through one distribution: 4 real paths -> 200 with four DISTINCT titles and h1s, 2 independent absent paths -> 404 carrying the origin's real WordPress 404 page (title '404 - Page not found - Opal Capital', h1 'Page not found'). The distribution was authored with NO custom_error_response block, deliberately and with the reason stated in cloudfront.tf, so the origin's genuine 404 reaches the viewer unaltered.

determinism.expected: Identical verdicts across repeats: the same status codes and the same IP-set denominator.
determinism.observed: Identical. The 4 real paths returned 200 on both passes with matching sizes, the absent paths returned 404 on both, and the IP-set census read 2 across 2 pages on both runs.
determinism.method: Each load-bearing read was repeated against the same applied world with the same instrument: the four real paths and the two absent paths were requested twice through https://dmq5420cdhgqf.cloudfront.net (once capturing status and byte size, once capturing response headers and the title/h1 content markers), and the fully-paginated CLOUDFRONT-scope IP-set census was run once before the apply and once after it.

declared_exclusions.item: Deliverable 4 -- the DNS cutover and the ACM certificate for opalinvest.com.
declared_exclusions.reason: NOT EXECUTABLE FROM THIS FABRIC, not deferred by choice. opalinvest.com has no Route53 hosted zone (denominator 2 zones, IsTruncated absent) and is delegated to GoDaddy ns47/ns48.domaincontrol.com, read authoritatively from GoDaddy's own nameserver. No ACM certificate for the name exists (us-east-1 denominator 1, opalinvest.dev only) and minting one requires a validation CNAME in that same GoDaddy zone, so the certificate and the cutover are blocked by ONE credential. A second independent carrier agrees: infra/aws/terraform/website/README.md calls the EIP 'the stable public IP handed to GoDaddy apex-A at W3 cutover'. Separately, the apex is an A record and CloudFront publishes no stable IP, and RFC 1034 s.3.6.2 forbids a CNAME at a zone apex -- so an ALIAS-class record is needed, which Route53 provides and whose GoDaddy equivalent is NOT ESTABLISHED here. Row NFRA_OPSEC202609-Z-S101, ARMED.

declared_exclusions.item: Deliverable 3 -- the /wp-admin and xmlrpc.php source-address restriction rules.
declared_exclusions.reason: The allowed addresses are an INPUT the face forbids inventing and none was supplied. The paths are left exactly as they were rather than guessed at, per S13-AC3's own instruction. Row NFRA_OPSEC202609-Z-S102, ARMED.

declared_exclusions.item: Graduating any managed rule group from Count to Block.
declared_exclusions.reason: Explicitly a later act on measured soak evidence shared with the portal's, per the face and the S-4-18 carrier. A group in Block here would enforce an unmeasured ruleset on live visitor traffic in front of a public marketing site and is a FAIL under S13-AC4, not a bonus. AWSManagedRulesBotControlRuleSet is unauthorized under PRD s.5 and is deliberately absent.

sg-062bbb40a6c92509c permits tcp/80 and tcp/443 from 0.0.0.0/0 and the EIP answers on both, so the origin serves non-edge traffic today and the edge is bypassable by requesting the address directly. S13-AC5 requires the security group to be IDENTICAL before and after, so closing it is explicitly NOT this face's act. Named here so that no claim in this instance is read as 'known-bad requests are refused' without its scope -- any refusal this face demonstrates is scoped to traffic that traversed the edge.

The distribution runs Managed-CachingDisabled. The cell's outcome is a SECURITY one -- a known-bad request refused before WordPress handles it -- not a performance one, and caching a logged-in WordPress response to the wrong viewer is a correctness and privacy defect. A WP-appropriate cookie/query-string cache policy is a separate, measured act.

surprises: NFRA_OPSEC202609-Z-S101: the DNS and certificate half of this face is not executable from this fabric -- opalinvest.com is delegated to GoDaddy with no Route53 zone and no ACM certificate, and the apex is an A record that CloudFront cannot be the target of without an ALIAS-class record. Resolves S13-AC2's and S13-AC3's custom-domain framing and both entries in declared_exclusions concerning the cutover. ARMED, disarm_owner 2.0.0_SA_COO~Z.

NFRA_OPSEC202609-Z-S102: the /wp-admin allow-list is absent as the face anticipated, but the consequence is wider than the face states -- the source-restriction rule is the only rule this face is authorized to build that can refuse anything, so its absence removes S13-AC2's only demonstration as well as making S13-AC3 uncomputable. Resolves the S13-AC2 and S13-AC3 UNCOMPUTABLE-BY-CONSTRUCTION dispositions above. ARMED, disarm_owner 2.0.0_SA_COO~Z.
